meta.rule: protocol v1.8.6 rule 1: screen every syndrome that changed, not only the headline one
meta.frame: current ledger rows excluded at title/abstract stage with a reason code, deduplicated by PMID, DOI or title
meta.method: Abstracts fetched from Europe PMC in the laptop browser (never stored in the repo); scored for two or more syndrome families plus improvement and unexpectedness wording; every record scoring 3 or more read by Claude; records without an abstract in Europe PMC screened by title, pending their PsycInfo or Embase abstracts in a CKN session.
